description: Options controlling a static wireframe page → SVG render.

members.name: Default
members.description: Shared default options (no grid, white background).

members.name: ShowGrid
members.description: When true, draws the canvas grid. Defaults to false — previews rarely want a grid.

members.name: ShowBackground
members.description: When true, draws the page background rectangle. Defaults to true.

members.name: BackgroundFill
members.description: Background fill colour used when ShowBackground is true. Defaults to "white".

members.name: StencilTheme
members.description: Stencil theme the page is drawn with (indigo, indigo-dark, dark, ...; decision WIREFRAME-STENCIL-THEME). null falls back to the page TargetTheme (and, in IWireframeSvgRenderer.RenderDocumentAsync, the document TargetTheme), then to the default tokens. An unknown name draws the default tokens and logs one warning.

examples.title: Transparent preview without a grid
